concerns.text: Task T012b instructs to 'stop when the cumulative dataset size approaches a substantial threshold,' which lacks a specific task to implement the 'representative set' logic defined in Spec FR-001 (fetch top Python/JS repos by star count). The task description is vague and does not explicitly cover the requirement to fetch a specific list of top repositories.

Tasks T018a and T018b are marked as unchecked [ ] but are critical for Spec FR-001 (save raw/processed data with schema validation). Without these tasks, the data pipeline cannot produce the required CSV/JSON outputs mandated by the spec.

Tasks T019b, T019c, and T019d (Spot Check workflow) are marked as unchecked [ ]. Spec FR-011 requires a manual spot-check to estimate false-negative rates. These tasks are essential for the validation step and are currently incomplete.

Tasks T023a (descriptive stats) and T023c (distribution characteristics) are marked as unchecked [ ]. Spec FR-004 and SC-002 require descriptive statistics and distribution characteristics. These tasks are missing implementation status.
Task T032 (boxplot axis labeling) is marked as unchecked [ ]. Spec FR-007 requires 'properly labeled axes'. This task is essential for the visualization requirement.
Task T036a (verify boxplot existence) is marked as unchecked [ ]. This is a prerequisite for T036b (report assembly) and ensures the artifact exists as required by FR-008.
Task T037 (update state.yaml) is marked as unchecked [ ]. Constitution Principle V requires updating state.yaml with artifact hashes. This task is missing implementation.
Tasks T039a and T039b (linting/formatting) are marked as unchecked [ ]. While not a functional requirement, they are part of the 'Polish' phase and ensure code quality as per plan constraints.
Tasks T041 (quickstart validation) and T042 (schema validation) are marked as unchecked [ ]. These are critical for verifying the pipeline's executability and data integrity as per the plan.
Task T002b has duplicate 'ATMIZE: requested' comments. This is a minor writing issue but should be cleaned up.
Task T042 is marked with [~] (in progress) but the description implies a final validation step. The status marker should be consistent with the task's completion state.
